title: YouTube videos
description: One row per delivered video, plus free status rows that explain what was not delivered.

dataset.title: Videos
dataset.description: Every delivered video carries actorInput, actorIndex, videoId, url, title, channelTitle, channelId, views, lengthSeconds, publishedAt, category, keywords, isLive, thumbnailUrl, playability, playabilityReason, description (with includeDescription), status and billable. Rows with a status other than OK carry reason instead of data: no videoId, no title, no thumbnail and no url. playability and playabilityReason are the answer this client got from YouTube, not a property of the video.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters: gateway (relay or direct), relayCalls, relayFallbacks, relayErrors, transports (rows per road), videosRequested, videosAttempted, videosRead, videosNotFound, videosInvalid, videosDuplicate, videosFailed, videosLimited, videosCutByBudget, videosCutByDeadline, videosCutByStop, videosDelivered, videosCapped, rowsWritten, byStatus, chargedEvents, deliveredUncharged, deliveredUnverified, chargeUncertain, writeErrors, summaryWriteErrors, billingActive, priceEvent, priceNote, includeDescription, maxVideos, counterMismatch, stopReason, datasetNote, startedAt, finishedAt. Status codes: OK, INVALID_INPUT, DUPLICATE, NOT_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT, NOT_CHECKED_TIME, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR, NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_BILLING. Stop reasons: dataset-write-error, billing-price-unknown, spending-cap, charge-error, deadline.
